rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: The page introduces '３０日の第６回公明党全国大会で選出された太田昭宏代表のあいさつ', which opens with his statement that at today's convention, having received the delegates' confidence, he has taken office as 公明党代表 ('本日の党大会において、全国の代議員の皆様のご信任を賜り、公明党代表に就任させていただきました太田昭宏でございます').

rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: In the same address he thanks '神崎武法前代表' for leading the party for four terms and eight years ('４期８年').
